name: Gray
dossier: THIS ENTITY STAYS DORMANT FOR 180 SECONDS AFTER ACTIVATION OR COLLECTING A RELAY, REDUCED TO 120 SECONDS ON NIGHTMARE. WHEN THAT GRACE ENDS, STANDING STILL IN THE OPEN FOR 45 SECONDS STARTS FIVE E-KEY PROMPTS; NIGHTMARE REDUCES THE IDLE LIMIT TO 30 SECONDS. EACH PROMPT ALLOWS 2.5 SECONDS, OR 1.8 SECONDS ON NIGHTMARE. COMPLETING ALL FIVE KEEPS THEM DORMANT. MISSING ONE MAKES HER VISIBLE AND STARTS A NORMAL CHASE UNTIL ANOTHER RELAY RESETS HER.
